title: Corresponding Responsibility
rule_summary: A controlled-substance prescription must be issued for a legitimate medical purpose in the usual course of professional practice; the pharmacist who knowingly fills an invalid prescription shares corresponding responsibility and must exercise an independent dispensing judgment when material red flags remain unresolved.
exam_relevance: Tests a distinct pharmacist decision path using current official authority rather than rote trivia.
verification_notes: Authoring-session current official-source verification on 2026-08-14; requires fresh independent audit before release.
